review_locator: PMCID:PMC8726596, Transcriptional and epigenetic regulation of memory NK cell responses; PMCID:PMC6811606, Transcriptional, Epigenetic and Pharmacological Control of JAK/STAT Pathway in NK Cells
primary_title: The transcription factor Zbtb32 controls the proliferative burst of virus-specific natural killer cells responding to infection
decision_basis: The reviews identify ZBTB32 as a direct STAT4-responsive NK-cell transcriptional target; the cited primary demonstrates IL-12/IL-18-induced STAT4 occupancy at conserved Zbtb32 promoter sites, associated active chromatin and reduced Zbtb32 induction when STAT4 signaling is absent.
limitations_preserved: Direct STAT4 promoter occupancy and cytokine-dependent chromatin/transcription evidence support a bounded NK-cell STAT4-to-ZBTB32 gene bridge; downstream BLIMP1 antagonism and antiviral expansion are context-specific, and no universal terminal-TF or SCI inference is made.
